content: In a footnote MK relays that Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī appears to have had connections to the Niʿmatullāh family in Taft, but that Binbaş concludes the relationship was probably no more than coexistence between local dignitaries.
refers_to_primary: Binbaş on Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī and the Niʿmatullāh family of Taft
